label: No placebo
rationale: This is a single-arm interventional feasibility study in which all participants receive the Stentrode device. The record describes no placebo, sham, or active-control comparator; the only arm is the device arm.

evidence.quote: The Stentrode is an endovascular electrode array that senses electrical signals from the sensorimotor cortices.

title: INdependence Through Endovascular Neuroprosthetic Technology (INTENT): an Early Feasibility Study
